# splitsecure_vault_node_grants (Resource)

Authoritative set of direct grants on one vault folder or record. Applying it makes the node's direct grants equal the grant blocks: missing grants are added, tiers are changed, and every other direct grant is removed. The grant of the service account Terraform signs in as is always kept, and grants inherited from parent folders are not touched. Destroying it removes the declared grants only. Import with vault_id/node_id.

Choosing a resource: this resource owns every direct grant on the node. Use splitsecure_vault_grant instead to add one grant and leave the others alone. Never use both on the same node.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_id` (String) Node id of the folder or record. A record's id is its node id. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `vault_id` (String) Vault the node is in. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `grant` (Block Set) One grantee and its tier. List every grantee that should have a direct grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grant))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource id in the form vault_id/node_id.

<a id="nestedblock--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Required:

- `grantee` (String) Full s2r of the principal, service account or group.
- `tier` (String) Access tier, one of: view, use, edit.
